phase: CSR-8 Phase I / I2 — Contextual Layer Preregistration & Cluster-Robust Analysis Design
mode: PREREGISTRATION_ONLY — no contextual analysis results are computed, reported, or implied by this contract; I3 executes the readout only after this contract is frozen and audited

frozen_rulings.taxonomy_v3: NO-GO. I1 found E=0 among the 20 non-dominant cases: no case requires a structure outside current taxonomy fields. The stock layer compresses graded/mixed evidence into an over-coarse binary expression; any future change is REPRESENTATION REFINEMENT (graded / mixed-state expression of the stock layer), never taxonomy expansion.
frozen_rulings.reversed_pairs: The 3 REVERSED pairs (etf_contraction 1v8 / 5v8 / 6v8) are frozen as SAMPLING-DEPENDENT STRUCTURE. Mechanism (I1, deterministic): shared cell-8 pool; 9 same-structure members at T=2021-04-06 (epoch-2, NO_PIT_VISIBLE_REPORT, c=8/e=0) lifted the cell-8 R5 median from -0.0362 to -0.0088; epoch-1 restriction reproduces the 64-corpus sign (d=+0.0224). They must NOT be re-interpreted as market-structure reversals.
frozen_rulings.i1_structural_conclusion: I1 found no new capital type requiring taxonomy_v3, but found (a) insufficient stock-layer representational granularity and (b) material influence of observation-date clustering on structure statistics. The next fixes belong to research design and interpretation layers, not to more categories.

analysis_policy.R1_immutable_labels: Original capital-state definitions are IMMUTABLE in Phase I. Context variables are modifiers only; they never rewrite, split, or re-label a capital state.
analysis_policy.R2_paired_statistics: Every I3 statistic must be reported in TWO columns side by side: (a) naive case-level (the frozen readout convention) and (b) cluster-aware per R3/R4. A naive-only report is invalid.
analysis_policy.R3_date_dedup: Cluster-aware recomputation = DATE-LEVEL AGGREGATION: for each (T, cell), reduce member cases to one value = median of their case R5 (R3/R10 analogously); all cell statistics (medians, deltas, Cliff's delta analogues) are then computed over DATES, not cases. A date with k same-cell cases contributes exactly ONE observation, never k.
analysis_policy.R4_cluster_robustness_hard_gate: A relation may be upgraded from 'descriptive corpus structure' to 'theory-layer conclusion' ONLY if ALL of: (a) naive direction holds; (b) date-dedup direction (R3) is unchanged; (c) leave-max-cluster-out direction is unchanged (drop the single largest date cluster entirely and recompute); (d) each side of the comparison rests on >= 5 distinct observation dates. Failing any clause freezes the relation as 'sampling-dependent' (the REVERSED precedent) — this is a classification, not an error to repair.
analysis_policy.R5_preregistered_relations: The ONLY relations eligible for R4 upgrade testing are the three preregistered PRESERVED targets: stock_layer_summary NOT_DISCLOSED vs NO_PIT_VISIBLE_REPORT; etf_expansion_count 4 vs 8; 8 vs 9. All other pairs remain exploratory and can never be upgraded without a new preregistration append.
analysis_policy.R6_pit_safety: Every context variable must be computable from data with available_date <= T. Any variable failing this at I3 time is dropped (reported as dropped), never repaired with post-T data.
analysis_policy.R7_margin_semantics: Margin variables describe leverage-participation temperature only (mixed participants). They must not be narrated as national-capital, 主力, or any single-actor evidence.
analysis_policy.R8_no_new_labels: taxonomy_v3 NO-GO stands for all of Phase I. Representation refinement (graded/mixed stock-layer expression) may only be DESIGNED as a proposal in I3 outputs; implementing it requires a new user ruling.
